Prevention: Maintain isolation distance from susceptible cucurbit species
Train (panthal) the vine in such a way to provide adequate aeration and exposure to sunlight
Thin out dense canopy of the vines
Avoid over head irrigation in disease prone areas
Monitoring: Observe for white powdery growth on lower surface and yellow discoloration on corresponding upper leaf surface during high moisture condition
In advance stages entire leaf dries
Direct Control: Rogue out diseased plants and remove affected plant debris from field
Restrictions: Use of personal protective equipment (PPEs) such as gloves, mask, goggles and keeping antidotes are mandatory by the spray applicators.
Azoxystrobin @ 0.1% at disease initiation stage and repeat at weekly interval.
